This endpoint is typically used to obtain a new access token when the current one has
            expired, provided a valid refresh token is supplied. The client must include a valid refresh token in the
            request body.

requestBody.description:
The command containing the refresh token and related information required to issue a new token pair. Cannot be
            null.

delete.summary: Logs out the currently authenticated user and invalidates their session.
Logs out the current user from all active devices and invalidates all authentication sessions.
delete.description:
This action signs the user out from all devices where they are currently authenticated. After
            calling this endpoint, all existing authentication tokens for the user will be invalidated, requiring
            re-authentication on all devices.

patch.summary: Handles a request to change the current user's password.
patch.description:
The user must be authenticated to change their password. The operation may fail if the
            current password is incorrect or if the new password does not meet security requirements.

requestBody.description:
An object containing the current password, the new password, and any additional information required to process
            the password change.

requestBody.description: The command containing the user identifier and the desired activity state. Cannot be null.

patch.summary: toggles the activity status of a user by their identifier. This endpoint allows administrators to activate or deactivate a user account based on the provided user ID. The operation will switch the user's status between active and inactive, depending on their current state.

toggles the busy status of a user by their identifier. This endpoint allows administrators to mark a user as busy or available based on the provided user ID. The operation will switch the user's busy status between true and false, depending on their current state.
